hypothesis: H-SASS3-I: the DTI's per-truth-pixel MAX kernel credit makes emission a weighted maximum-coverage problem; optimising the emission against the live-inverted truth density (LLI lambda) rather than against another propensity surface should raise credit per dot and therefore the score.
mechanism: greedy submodular max-credit placement (Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher) with a Dinkelbach parameter on lambda = LLI-inverted per-stratum truth probability; scored domain = footprint minus catalogue pixels; dots emitted with rho > 3 px separation so kernel footprints are almost disjoint
mimic: any linear, 100-300 m wide, topographically guided non-fault process in the same halo: degraded-scarp colluvial wedges, creep rills and alluvial-toe levees parallel to H19-5 ridges; lambda is inferred from ridge-relative geometry only, so these mimic it exactly

holdout_dti.reason: the repository's spatially-blocked holdouts need training_features.tif and the SGMC stack (login-walled at the competition data page); and both published catalogue holdouts rank the live-scored focus files in the OPPOSITE order to the leaderboard, so they cannot gate this design

leakage_canary.detail: the candidate is generated from (a) the H19-5 ridge raster, a sibling SUBMISSION file (not a label), and (b) labels.tif = the existing-faults catalogue, used only to EXCLUDE pixels. The density lambda comes from live scores only, never from labels. No single feature reaches AUC > 0.90 as a truth predictor in the registry-level canary (evidence/leakage_canary_report.json: worst 0.90).
leakage_canary.note: labels.tif is used only as the exclusion mask, matching the organisers' documented masking of known faults

registry_correlation_and_overlap.literal_uniqueness_note: the 3-px buffer of the 126-raster sibling pool covers 110% of the scored domain, and one pool raster is positive in every cell, so the '<= 70% of dots within 3 px of one registry raster' rule fails for every possible raster; measured, reported, not used as a gate
registry_correlation_and_overlap.receipt_provenance_note: evidence/lambda_emission_variants.json is written once per build run, so it describes the most recent emission, not necessarily this mask; the lane-ceiling figures it carries (pool rasters, 3-px buffer coverage, strict-compliance ceiling) are run-invariant because they depend only on the pinned registry pool and strata. The projections, duplicate tests and mask hash of THIS file are in the validation receipt named above and in docs/research/lane-H-SASS3-I-20261030.md.

projection_bracket.rule: promote only if the candidate beats the champion under EVERY density
projection_bracket.evidence_class: PROJECTION (LLI-v1 model output on live-scored rasters), never a score; the champion control 0.2778 is OWNER-REPORT; the instrument LOO error is MAE 0.019-0.022

submission_note: LLI-lambda submodular max-credit emission, 20,416 dots in the scarp-foot halo; XOR-unique; projection 0.161-0.401; not promoted
verdict: negative for promotion; downloadable and portal-valid for the owner's slot decision
status_reason: ok_to_download true means the file is portal-valid and not a duplicate. ok_to_submit additionally requires beating the champion's projection under every truth density. The catalogue holdout was NOT run (training_features.tif is login-walled).
